summary: Iteration-5 verification for BUG-005, BUG-010, BUG-011, BUG-018, BUG-019, BUG-020 plus a regression smoke. Added /app/backend/tests/test_bugfixes_iteration5.py (8 focused tests). Combined pytest run (iter5 + iter4 + backend_test.py + test_phase3_sales_billing.py) = 108/108 passing after rate_limits flush. Frontend smoke on preview URL confirms: (BUG-005) /admin -> Integrations renders setting-state-SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES = 'not set — using default 60', DEFAULT_TRIAL_DAYS = 'not set — using default 14', BILLING_GRACE_DAYS = 'not set — using default 7' and GET /api/admin/settings returns a 'default' key per setting; (BUG-011) var-serviceDue-appointment_date & var-serviceDue-appointment_time chips are disabled + line-through, typing {appointment_date} into template-body-serviceDue produces template-warning-serviceDue ('{appointment_date} will be blank in real texts — this message is not tied to an appointment.') and template-state-serviceDue flips to 'Unsaved changes — preview shows your edit'; (BUG-018 backend) POST /api/billing/change-plan with no active sub returns 400 'Subscribe to a plan first.' — demo tenant has no live subscription so settings-tab-billing renders plan-starter + subscribe-starter (not change-plan-section), matching spec; (BUG-019) CSV row with year='notayear' is rejected into errors[] with a message mentioning 'year', no contact is created, and valid rows alongside it still import; (BUG-020) Customers page customer-count = '90 customers' and Dashboard checklist copy '37 of 90 customers have SMS consent' both read from /dashboard.kpis.customers — numerically identical. YES/CANCEL routing (BUG-010) is now covered by 3 backend tests: (a) with 2 upcoming scheduled appointments and a confirmation seeded for the later one, YES confirms that later one (not the nearest) and no needs-attention audit fires; (b) with 2 upcoming and no reminders sent, YES confirms the nearest scheduled one; (c) CANCEL with ambiguous context leaves both scheduled and writes an appointment.reply-needs-attention audit. Regression smoke: owner login + /, /calendar, /customers, /automations, /settings tabs render; /book/demo-auto-toronto loads for public; staff access-denied path was validated in iter-4 and tests still pass. SMS mode held in simulated throughout (test fixture restores prior value).
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py change_plan returns 400 with 'Subscribe to a plan first.' when t.stripe_subscription is missing (matches spec); but the AppError raised has no explicit status so it falls to default 400 — fine, just worth noting that /api/billing/change-plan 400 vs 409 disambiguation relies on message text, not code.

crm.py import_contacts year validation is correct ('yr.isdigit() and 1900 <= int(yr) <= 2100'), but the row is only rejected when make/plate/year columns are present on the row; a row with phone+name only (no vehicle columns) will still import — that's intentional per code comment but worth calling out so UX stays consistent.

messaging.py inbound YES/CANCEL logic: the ambiguity escalation requires len(upcoming) > 1 AND no 'target' resolved. If a customer has exactly ONE upcoming appointment, kw=='CANCEL' always cancels it even if the customer intended to cancel a different (completed/past) appointment. That's a reasonable product choice (single upcoming = unambiguous) but should be documented in staff training.

admin.py SETTING_DEFAULTS exposes ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID default as a human string 'burt (Vapi default)' — rendered verbatim in the UI as 'not set — using default burt (Vapi default)' when unset; that's a minor UX nit (reads awkwardly). Not blocking.

frontend/src/pages/Customers.tsx shows customer-count only when results exist (and switches to 'N matches' for filtered search). BUG-020 parity is intact for the unfiltered case which is what the request specifies, but if a user filters and the dashboard caller expects list == kpi they'd mismatch. That's intended but worth a product note.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke-tested selectors present (setting-state-*, var-serviceDue-* chips disabled+line-through, template-warning-serviceDue, settings-tab-billing + plan-starter + subscribe-starter, customer-count = 90 matches dashboard 'of 90 customers' copy)

seed_data_creation: Backend iter-5 tests create ~5 ephemeral TEST_B10_*, TEST_V, TEST_BadYear, TEST_Bad, TEST_Good contacts (+1 416 xxx) and ~6 appointments on the demo tenant 20-60 days in the future. Fixture _force_simulated_sms sets SMS_MODE='simulated' at module start and restores the prior value on teardown. All rows TEST_-prefixed for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pytest suite now has FOUR files all run via /app/backend/pytest.ini (-n 2 --dist loadscope). Order of relevance: backend_test.py (44, Phase 0/1/2), test_phase3_sales_billing.py (37, Phase 3+5), test_bugfixes_iteration4.py (19, BUG-001..017), test_bugfixes_iteration5.py (8, BUG-005/010/011/018/019/020). Run `pytest backend/tests/` from /app. If signup-based tests return 429, flush with `python -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; MongoClient('mongodb://localhost:27017')['test_database'].rate_limits.delete_many({})"`. BUG-018 is only verifiable without-subscription here; the full upgrade/downgrade with Stripe Checkout + card 4242 must be exercised in a browser session on the preview URL (webhooks may not reach preview; /api/payments/status/{session_id} polling applies the subscription on success_url). SMS_MODE must be 'simulated' for /messages/simulate-reply tests — iter-5 fixture handles this automatically.
rca of the issue: No new product bugs surfaced in iteration 5. All six targeted fixes verified end-to-end at backend level; UI selectors in BillingPanel/Automations/Admin/Customers render exactly the data-testids called out in the review request.
